Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Panaji Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the application form for ECHS Panaji Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 20 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released in ECHS Panaji Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies have been released by ECHS Panaji for Various Posts. These include positions like Officer in charge, Dental Officer, Pharmacist, and others across different locations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS Panaji Various Posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for ECHS Panaji Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What are the salary details for ECHS Panaji Various Posts?
faq.answer: The salary for ECHS Panaji Various Posts ranges from Rs. 21800/- to Rs. 95000/- Per Month, depending on the specific post. Detailed salary for each post is provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for ECHS Panaji Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for ECHS Panaji Various Posts includes an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum qualifications required for ECHS Panaji Various Posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications vary by post, including Graduate with 5 years experience, BDS with 3 years experience, GNM Diploma, B Pharmacy, Diploma in Dental Hygiene, 8th Class, and Literate candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ECHS Panaji Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ECHS Panaji Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for ECHS Panaji Various Posts?
faq.answer: The job locations for the various posts under ECHS Panaji Recruitment are Panaji (Goa) and Sindhudurg. Specific posts are allocated to each location as per the notification.
